title: Roadstorm versioned scenario/reference fixture (scenario fixture schema version 1)
description: Fixture contract for the scenario configuration contract in scenario.schema.json and the reference record contract in reference_run.schema.json, defined at M0.9 from docs/BENCHMARKS.md ('Reference driver and records', 'AI metrics', 'Tactical comparison'), docs/GAME_DESIGN.md (Arcade Rush budgets) and docs/TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md ('Content contracts'). A fixture bundles one scenario configuration with the reference records it depends on, the behavioral expectations the fixtures/scenario validator checks semantically, and the documented initial acceptance targets. Like the sibling handling and intent fixture contracts, this is a text contract: numeric values are authored initial values or documented targets, never measurements. A value that is not yet determined is JSON null and MUST be listed in 'unknowns'; the validator enforces that pairing in both directions. A fixture may not contain a measured or superseded reference record: measured evidence is produced later by M1/M4 capture tooling as separate artifacts, and an authored file must not impersonate a record. Companion vocabulary lives in ../common.schema.json. This fixture defines no simulation, capture or evaluation implementation; a valid fixture is a well-formed contract, not a completed test.

schema_version.description: Contract revision identifier. A fixture whose schema_version differs is rejected, not silently migrated.

fixture_family.description: Which benchmark this fixture instantiates; must equal the enclosed scenario's scenario_family (the validator checks the agreement).

revision.description: Fixture content revision. Any semantic change to the scenario, records, expectations or metrics bumps this and recomputes content_hash.

status.description: provisional = authored initial contract, not yet executed; example = contract illustration that deliberately instantiates unratified producers (learned policies, unbuilt planners) without claiming they exist. 'measured' is not valid: fixtures carry targets and requirements, never measured outcomes.

scenario.description: The scenario configuration this fixture fixes.

reference_records.description: Reference records the fixture depends on, embedded so the fixture is self-contained. Every record must be status 'planned' at M0.9; a scenario's 'reference' member must resolve to one of these.

expectations.description: Contract expectations the validator checks. Each names a semantic check the validator implements and the part it applies to; a check id the validator does not implement is a fixture error, so expectations cannot drift from the executable checks.

metrics.description: Documented initial targets from BENCHMARKS/GAME_DESIGN. A metric with status 'measured' is invalid in a fixture file; measured values belong to reference records and evaluation reports.

unknowns.description: Every JSON null in this document must have a matching entry here (dotted path, e.g. reference_records.0.results.statistics.median_s), and every entry must point at a null: a value must not appear determined while it is not, and an explained value must not be null.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8) of this file with the content_hash member removed. Recomputed by the validator on every check.

path.description: Part of the fixture the expectation applies to, e.g. scenario, reference_records.0, or '' for the whole document.

statement.description: Human-readable restatement of the specified behavior being checked.
